config_used.description: Configuration for calculating inter-feature activation similarity metrics between decoder-similar features. Outputs RAW data with ALL pairs - filtering/classification done in script 7.

dependencies: 3_features_parquet.py must be run first (for decoder_similarity field)
4_act_embeddings.py must be run first (for pre-computed embeddings)
processing_notes.pairwise_computation: 16 main examples × 16 selected examples for calculation; 8×8 for position tracking
processing_notes.filtering_note: Thresholds and pattern classification moved to script 7_interfeature_display.py
processing_notes.position_tracking: char_offset and token positions stored per prompt_id for frontend highlighting

field_descriptions.all_pairs: ALL feature pairs with decoder-similar features (no filtering)
field_descriptions.similar_feature_id: ID of the decoder-similar feature being compared
field_descriptions.decoder_similarity: Decoder weight cosine similarity from features.parquet
field_descriptions.semantic_similarity: Average pairwise cosine similarity of embeddings
field_descriptions.char_jaccard: Character-level n-gram Jaccard similarity (overall set overlap)
field_descriptions.word_jaccard: Word-level n-gram Jaccard similarity (overall set overlap)
field_descriptions.main_prompt_ids: List of prompt IDs analyzed from main feature (max 16 for calculation)
field_descriptions.similar_prompt_ids: List of prompt IDs analyzed from similar feature (max 16 for calculation)
field_descriptions.num_comparisons: Total number of pairwise comparisons performed
field_descriptions.max_char_ngram_size: Size of most frequent character n-gram
field_descriptions.max_char_ngram_jaccard: Specific Jaccard for max_char_ngram: fraction of (main, selected) pairs where both contain this n-gram
field_descriptions.max_word_ngram_size: Size of most frequent word n-gram
field_descriptions.max_word_ngram_jaccard: Specific Jaccard for max_word_ngram: fraction of (main, selected) pairs where both contain this n-gram
field_descriptions.main_char_ngram_positions: List of {prompt_id, positions: [{token_position, char_offset}]} for main feature (8 examples with positions)
field_descriptions.similar_char_ngram_positions: List of {prompt_id, positions: [{token_position, char_offset}]} for similar feature (8 examples with positions)
field_descriptions.main_word_ngram_positions: List of {prompt_id, positions: [token_positions]} for main feature (8 examples with positions)
field_descriptions.similar_word_ngram_positions: List of {prompt_id, positions: [token_positions]} for similar feature (8 examples with positions)

notes.v5_changes: Removed threshold filtering. All pairs saved to all_pairs list. Pattern classification (semantic/lexical) moved to script 7.
notes.workflow: Run this script first to compute all pairs, then run script 7 to apply thresholds and classify patterns.
